question: How do the nine deposited day-four libraries differ in relative RNA abundance across deficient and control groups?
decision: Quantify the published anchors and the complete adapted contrast; assess whether excluding the lone fl/+ library changes direction.
strongest_rival: Biological-unit dependence, culture selection and unknown genotype-correlated blocks can produce the observed group pattern.
discriminator: Show separate library values and the pooled versus +/+ comparison. Neither identifies mouse relationships, a batch effect, or uniform within-cell regulation.
exposure_record: Published S3B–C outcomes and Dp1 directions are known. GEO/ENA/BioSample identities, source methods and the count header have been inspected. Subsequent stages explicitly record additional exposure.
biological_unit: Deposited day-4 bulk RNA library; source mouse or pool unit is unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Nine unique BioSample and library/run accessions. Mouse/pool reuse and processing blocks are unresolved. Wang article and GEO reanalysis are shared-source evidence.
population_and_selection: C57BL/6 initially CD62L-high Tregs cultured for 96 hours with CD3/CD28 stimulation and IL-2. Viable recovered cell composition after culture is unresolved.
contrast: Four fl/fl libraries minus all five deposited controls, with +/+ only (four libraries) as sensitivity.
endpoint: Log2 ratio of group means of normalized RNA counts, per-library normalized anchor reads, and sample PCA.
methods: Python 3.12.10, numpy 2.5.1 and matplotlib 3.11.1. Size factors from positive-all-libraries gene geometric means and per-library median ratios, centered at geometric mean one. Pseudocount 0.5 in each group mean. Exact Ensembl release 78 stable IDs; mark nonunique symbols. PCA on centered log2(normalized reads + 1) of rank-eligible genes.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep all 43,432 rows, identify zeros and low counts. Blank contrast for all-zero rows. Rank eligibility is count >=10 in at least four libraries. No sample exclusions from the primary comparison.
multiplicity: Descriptive outputs only; no gene-level or set-level tests.
precision_basis: No sampling uncertainty is estimated for the finite deposited libraries.
interpretation_limit: No animal-population inference, cell-state or functional effect, tumor specificity or independent replication.
stop_rule: Stop on inconsistent source/group identity, absent normalization reference or unmappable published anchors. No population inference without verified units and design.
amendment_reason: First descriptive execution. S1 found a mixed control and did not verify independent biological units; use the prospectively amended descriptive route in EXECUTION_AMENDMENT_V1.md.
